'''Premiere Traditional''' is the 56th virtual expansion set  published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 6 December, 2024 as part of the year-long 30th anniversary of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. The set consists of 363 cards.

Premiere Traditional is a very special type of expansion, something both new and old. A traditional expansion brings the cards as they existed when Decipher "retired" First Edition. In Premiere Traditional, you'll find everything as it was in Decipher's Glossary 1.6. Some changes were made, but none of them are to the gameplay that Decipher-only fans will know and love. These cards have an expansion icon as well as card numbers and rarities. These modern touches are required both to keep the cards distinct, and to mark them as being legal in Traditional / Decipher-only formats. That's what the "T" in the card rarities means - TC for Traditional Common, TU for Traditional Uncommon, and TR for Traditional Rare. Cards with a "T" in their rarity are legal in all First Edition Traditional / Decipher-only tournaments, and are not legal in any Modern formats.

The other change is that these cards feature the game text as it was left by Decipher. Any and all changes made in the CC-era of First Edition have been reverted in Premiere Traditional. The game text of Q allowing rearranging of the spaceline is back, with any changes made by the Continuing Committee removed. Likewise with other staple cards like Borg Ship and Vulcan Mindmeld: they're back they way you remember them! But now, they are in glorious high resolution - no more blurry, ancient GIFs from the earliest days of the Internet. All 363 cards are remade in clean, clear, and crisp high quality.

Premiere Traditional is the first step in The Continuing Committee’s renewed focus on Traditional / Decipher-only players. Their tech team has been working hard behind the scenes to support this new style of expansion, and will be continuing to work on new tools as they move forward. Their goal is to make it easier for players to find Traditional versions of cards, build Traditional decks, and find other Traditional players and events.
